output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is zero, the 'balanceOf[_to] + _value' evaluation will always fail the assert due to underflow. This can be exploited to make any user's balance zero, aka the 'differential rights' vulnerability.

The 'burn' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'amount' is zero, the 'totalSupply -= amount' evaluation will always fail the assert due to underflow. This can be exploited to increase a user's balance and decrease totalSupply, aka the 'differential rights' vulnerability.

The 'setPrices' function has an integer deviation vulnerability. Both 'newSellPrice' and 'newBuyPrice' are set without any maxMin checks, allowing these values to be set to zero, causing buy and sell functions to become inoperable.
